question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date))
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-25') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) = 25;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-25
  (
    -- Age = 25 if birth_date's year + 25 <= 2026 and (birth_date's month, day) <= (09-25)
    -- and (birth_date's year + 26 > 2026 or (birth_date's month, day) > (09-25))
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 <= 2026
    AND CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 9 * 100 + 25
    AND (
      CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26 > 2026
      OR CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) > 9 * 100 + 25
    )
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 = 2026
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09'
    AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = '25'
  )
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-25 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-09-26 00:00:00';
